pages.title: Modular Equipment
pages.text: Tools made from Draconium have no special abilities by themselves. Capacitors, tools, bows, staffs, and chestpieces are containers for modules. The equipment tier determines its internal space and the modules it can accept, while its actual abilities depend on the modules placed inside.

pages.title: Energy Supply
pages.text: Modular equipment requires energy to operate, so space must first be reserved for Energy Modules. A capacitor also needs Energy Modules and an external OP supply before it can charge other items. Remaining space can be used for damage, mining area, speed, shields, flight, or other functions.
